title: Lior and the Ember
author: Cyrus Winterbourne
blurb: Rafael Eriksen, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
